xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5633: Codex auth banner never fires for app-server conversations: burned refresh token left an agent failing silently for 14h

plan.title: Codex auth banner never fires for app-server conversations: burned refresh token left an agent failing silently for 14h
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: A Codex conversation failed every turn for 14 hours on an already-used refresh token while the dashboard showed nothing. The banner's burn signal depends on an agent-state flag nothing writes any more, the route passes no agent states, the static classifier cannot see a used refresh token, the Codex parser keeps isWorking true after a failed turn because no agent message is written, and the banner polls only every 120 s.
narratives.Proposal: Derive the failure from the rollout: the newest turn-end event, a task_complete carrying error.codex_error_info (unauthorized / context_window_exceeded). One leaf reader (codex-thread-status.ts) classifies it; the Codex parser ends turns on task_complete and renders Turn failed rows; conversation rows carry providerError with kind and authRecovered; a cached scan of live Codex sessions feeds GET /api/settings/codex-auth, the reauth-status route, the issue-spawn route and the CLI spawn gate; a failure older than ~/.codex/auth.json's mtime counts as healed. The banner polls every 30 s. The dead burn-flag code is deleted. Conversation-panel UX (row state word, notice with Hand off) is split into PAN-5636.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing classifyNativeCodexAuth's static rules
- Auto-retrying prompts or auto-sending a message after re-auth
- Auto-handoff of a context-full conversation
- Blocking message delivery to a conversation while its sign-in is burned
- Changing the CLIProxy log-based burn check (evaluateBurnedFromLog)
- A WebSocket push channel for the auth status (polling stays)
- Detecting failures in stopped sessions or vault browse copies
- Mapping Codex usageLimitExceeded to usageLimit with a reset time
- Writing any new agent-state field, flag or database column for the failure
- Adding a new HTTP route
- The Command Deck row state word and composer notice with Hand off (sibling issue PAN-5636)

autoDecisions.summary: Derive the burn signal from the rollout's task_complete.error instead of writing the agent-state burn flag the issue's agent notes suggest
autoDecisions.rationale: Conversations have no state.json, the dashboard route passes no agent states, and the repo invariant is that Overdeck stores no status it can derive; the rollout already records every failed turn with a structured codex_error_info.

autoDecisions.summary: Classify by codex_error_info first, message regex only as a fallback
autoDecisions.rationale: The structured code (unauthorized, context_window_exceeded) was verified in the incident rollout and app-server schema; text matching alone is brittle across CLI versions.

autoDecisions.summary: After re-auth show 'sign-in fixed, send a message to resume' rather than auto-retrying
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue allows either; auto-retry replays prompts and, as in the incident, can fail again on a full context. Showing the state is reversible and safe.

autoDecisions.summary: Banner poll 30 s with a 15 s single-flight scan cache
autoDecisions.rationale: Meets the issue's one-minute target (worst case about 45 s) while bounding the 5,100-dir agent-state scan to one per 15 s across all tabs.

autoDecisions.summary: Delete the dead burn-flag readers and switch the CLI spawn gate to the same scan
autoDecisions.rationale: The readers have no writer since PAN-3917; keeping them leaves a gate that can never fire. spawn.ts stays net-zero lines.

autoDecisions.summary: Split the conversation-panel UX (row state word, composer notice, Hand off button) into sibling issue PAN-5636
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps this plan inside the 25-file finalize limit; the UX consumes only providerError.kind and authRecovered and ships independently.

autoDecisions.summary: Put the CodexAuthFailure type in the leaf codex-thread-status.ts module
autoDecisions.rationale: Breaks the ordering knot between the scan module and codex-auth.ts and keeps codex-auth.ts an import leaf for lint:circular.
